Low-gravity moon making it impossible to walk normally? The §6Area Gravity Controller§f creates a configurable sphere of artificial gravity that works on any surface, planet, asteroid, or custom structure.

Vanilla recipe: titanium sheets, Mass Detector satellite function, and a Warp Core. The GUI lets you set gravity strength (0.0 to 2.0x Earth normal) and field radius (16-256 blocks). The field is spherical and passes through walls.

Multiple controllers link together to extend the field. Set to 1.0x on low-gravity moons for normal walking, or 0.5x on high-gravity gas giants to prevent fall damage.

§ePS:§f The Warp Core in the recipe is expensive. Build 1-2 controllers unless you have surplus. One controller covers a decent base area at moderate radius.
